full_name: Lisa Diller | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2018–2019 Medicine Lillian Gollay Knafel Fellow Harvard Medical School
bio: Lisa Diller is a pediatric oncologist and professor of pediatrics at Harvard Medical School. She is a clinician and researcher at the Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, where she leads the program in cancer survivorship, studying late outcomes in long-term survivors and caring for patients.
